name: Online order fulfilment
description: Acme receives and processes EU customer order, contact, and fulfilment data to validate purchases, ship goods, manage returns, and provide order status updates.

name: Customer support case management
description: Acme customer care teams and HelpDeskHQ process support requests, order context, ticket text, and attachments to resolve post-sale questions, returns, and warranty issues for EU customers.

name: Email marketing campaign operations
description: Acme uses MarketReach to manage opt-in promotional email campaigns, audience segmentation, suppression handling, and engagement reporting for EU customers and prospects.

name: B2B partner meeting transcription
description: Acme partnership teams use tl;dv to record, transcribe, and summarize selected remote meetings with prospective B2B partners so attendees can prepare follow-up actions and preserve an accurate record of negotiations. The service should be configured for EEA-hosted processing only, with optional US-based summary features disabled unless a separate transfer review is approved.
